A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same OmniAudio study. Their complete main texts and Appendices A–H, including equations, tables and figures, are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, human MOS results, ablations and qualitative analyses in Section 5 and Appendices G–H.

after.justification: v3 retains these original results and adds inference-time measurements and a comparison of alternative local-view configurations.

M1.justification: The spatial VAE, coarse-to-fine masked pre-training, dual-branch conditioning and flow-matching objectives remain unchanged. v3 describes the 120° frontal view as the original design; the additional multi-view configurations are experimental alternatives, not a replacement method.

E1.justification: Training still uses FreeSound, AudioSet, VGGSound and Sphere360, with evaluation on Sphere360-Bench and YT360. The added ablation varies views extracted from existing panoramas without introducing a new dataset, task or test population.

E2.justification: The Table 2 baselines and Table 10 VAE comparators are retained. New Table 11 adds ERP+2FOV Cuts, ERP+4FOV Cuts and ERP+6FOV Cuts as controlled comparison variants against the existing frontal-view design.

E3.justification: v3 adds inference time as an evaluation measure and experiments with two, four and six local views in Appendix G. Existing splits, sampling rates, training budgets and human-evaluation settings remain unchanged. The default 120° frontal view is newly documented rather than demonstrably changed.

E4.justification: Appendix G adds a targeted ablation testing whether additional local views improve the original frontal-view branch. The earlier pre-training, ERP/EAC, model-size, guidance-scale and VAE analyses, along with the failure case and qualitative examples, are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report MOS means and standard deviations in Table 2 and retain 15 participants and 50 samples per annotator in Appendix E.2. v3 adds no repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval or significance-testing information.

E6.justification: Existing benchmark and ablation scores are unchanged. Table 2 adds parameter counts and inference times, including 0.92 seconds for OmniAudio. Table 11 adds FD values of 95.84, 92.89 and 90.16 for two, four and six views, versus 88.30 for the retained frontal configuration; six views yield angular error 1.26 versus 1.28.

T1.justification: The flow-matching definitions and objectives in Equations 1–4, spatial-angle calculations and FOA encoding formulas are unchanged. No new formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same central contributions: 360V2SA, Sphere360, the OmniAudio training and dual-branch framework, and leading objective and subjective performance. The additional experiments support rather than redefine these claims.

C2.justification: Appendix G newly argues that frontal conditioning preserves the best FD/KL while achieving spatial accuracy similar to multi-view alternatives, supporting the existing design choice. Section 5.3 narrows the out-of-view failure attribution from FoV-based models generally to MMAudio. Existing multi-source failure limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The abstract changes code and datasets from a promised release to stated availability. v3 specifies the default frontal 120° view, documents alternative cut directions and supplies model parameter counts. Existing training hardware and hyperparameters are retained; measurement conditions for the new inference times are not specified.

R1.justification: v3 adds references to rectified-flow transformers, the Sora review and Wav2SQL, and moves the AudioLCM citation from flow-matching examples to the diffusion discussion. These are limited changes; the overall positioning and novelty claims remain stable.

P1.justification: Edits include localized FoV-to-perspective terminology changes, explanatory footnotes, author and affiliation updates, acknowledgements and a short impact-statement addition. Most prose and section organization are retained. The added ethical-development sentence ends unfinished.

P2.justification: Table 2 is reorganized into in-distribution and out-of-distribution blocks with parameter and inference-time columns, and Table 11 is added. Figure 2 updates its perspective-video label. Other tables and qualitative figures undergo local relocation and page reflow rather than substantive visual redesign.

improvement.justification: v3 strengthens an underdocumented design choice by specifying the frontal crop and testing alternative view counts in Table 11. Reported resource availability and parameter information also improve reproducibility documentation. The gains are limited: core results remain unchanged, timing conditions are unspecified, and minor editorial defects persist.
